sourcesContent: import axios from'axios';const api=axios.create({baseURL:process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL||'http://localhost:8080/api'});api.interceptors.request.use(c=>{const t=sessionStorage.getItem('token');if(t)c.headers.Authorization=`Bearer ${t}`;return c});api.interceptors.response.use(r=>r,e=>{if(e.response?.status===401&&sessionStorage.getItem('token')){sessionStorage.clear();window.location='/login'}return Promise.reject(e)});export const message=e=>e.response?.data?.message||e.response?.data||'Unable to complete the request';export default api;
